metrics.result:
I made an 8-second, 16:9 donut chart video of your budget. Rent is 40%, Salaries 35%, Marketing 15% and Other 10%, with a "Where our budget goes" title above it. The ring draws on, and there's a slow zoom and a pulse before the end. I checked one frame at 7 s, and the labels and figures read clearly. I didn't watch the rendered MP4 itself.

The `agentfx` command on PATH is a wrapper that points at a renderer that doesn't exist, so I ran the real binary at `$AGENTFX_HOME/target/release/agentfx` with its own renderer instead. Lint reports 0 errors and 0 warnings. You'll need the same workaround if you re-render.

The legend shows "40 %" with a space, which is the renderer's default, and the center label reads "40%".

Files are in `/tmp/claude-1000/agentfx-evals-full/full-31/data-budget-donut`:
- `film.reel`
- `out/film.mp4`

checklist.item: pie or donut chart with four slices
checklist.evidence: Donut with green, light green, yellow, red segments.
Legend lists Rent, Salaries, Marketing, Other.
Legend shows 40/35/15/10 %, and slice sizes look proportional.
At 0.33s the donut is only partly drawn (one arc), and it is complete by 1.67s.

problems: The chart and legend are small for the 1080p frame, with empty space at the sides and bottom.
The two greens (Rent and Salaries) are similar, and the legend dots are tiny, so matching legend to slice is hard.
The centre reads '40% RENT' and the legend text is small and low-contrast, so the other slices aren't labelled directly.
After the intro the motion is minimal. The zoom and pulses are subtle, and the chart is static for most of the 8 s.
The legend shows '40 %' with a space and the percentages are light weight, which looks slightly unpolished.
judge.verdict: Correct and clean. The data is right and the chart animates in, but the layout is small and generic and the motion after the intro is weak.
